What we do

Full-spectrum roofing across Leeds and Yorkshire.

Domestic and commercial. From a single slipped tile to a full re-roof — every job is carried out by NVQ-qualified, City & Guilds tradesmen.

🔧

Roof Repairs

Slipped tiles, leaks, ridges and flashings. Diagnosed properly, fixed once.

🏠

Re-Roofing

Full strip and re-roof using slate, tile or man-made. Workmanship guarantee.

🏘️

Flat Roofing

Felt, GRP fibreglass and EPDM rubber — extensions, garages, dormers.

⛰️

Yorkshire Stone

Specialist stone roof repairs and full restorations — local heritage work.

⚒️

Lead Work

Chimney flashings, valleys and bay roofs. Lead specialist with 25+ years on the tools.

📏

Fascias, Soffits & Guttering

UPVC and timber boards, full guttering replacement and repairs.

🪟

Velux Windows

Supply and fit Velux roof windows — neat finish, fully weathertight.

🚨

Emergency Call-Outs

24/7 response across Leeds. Storm damage, leaks, blow-offs — call anytime.

Meet Jonathan

Family-run since 2000. Same hands, same standards.

I'm Jonathan, the bloke behind A & L Roofing. We're a small family firm based in Scholes — over 25 years' experience covering Leeds, Wetherby, Garforth and the surrounding area.

Every job is done by qualified tradesmen — NVQ levels 1, 2 and 3, City & Guilds, and full Health & Safety training. No subcontracting. When you ring us, you get me — the person quoting the job and the person doing it.

We work with homeowners and commercial properties, and we provide skips and scaffolding in every quote — one less thing for you to think about.

Common questions

Things Leeds homeowners ask us.

Most repairs we can do within 1–2 weeks. Emergencies (active leaks, storm damage) we attend the same day where possible. The main delay is usually weather — we won't open up a roof if heavy rain is forecast.
Yes. Public liability insurance on every job. We can supply our certificate before work starts if you'd like to see it.
No. Quotes are free, and there's no charge for us coming out to look at the job — even if you don't go ahead.
Yes — every job comes with a workmanship guarantee. Materials are covered by manufacturer warranties (up to 25 years on flat roofing systems).
Call us on 0113 264 4705 — we cover emergencies 24/7. If we can't get to you the same day, we'll talk you through stopping the worst of it (buckets, tarpaulins) until we arrive.
